description.value: A proof-of-concept real-time fMRI neurofeedback study training healthy participants to down-regulate right amygdala activity during negative emotional stimulation across four sessions.

spans.text: As such, our goal was to develop and examine the feasibility of using online neurofeedback to assist participants in self-reduction of amygdala activity.

description.value: A longitudinal single-group repeated-measures proof-of-concept study with four training sessions in six healthy participants.

spans.text: The main limitation of this study is the lack of a control group performing only emotion regulation without contingent feedback.
